chapterInfo.content:
3
Ɔkasa mu ahosohwɛ
1Me nuanom, mommma mo mu bebree nnyɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, na monim sɛ yɛbɛnya afobuo kɛseɛ mmom. 2Ɛfiri sɛ yɛn nyinaa fom wɔ nnoɔma bebree mu. Sɛ obi mfom asɛm mu a, ɔno ara na ɔyɛ onipa a ɔwie pɛyɛ a ɔbɛtumi ato nipadua nyinaa nnareka adi soɔ. 3Yɛde nnareka to apɔnkɔ ano mu sɛ wɔntie yɛn, na yɛdanedane wɔn kɔ faako a yɛpɛ. 4Hwɛ, ɛhyɛn nso a ɛsoso sɛɛ, na mframa a emu yɛ den pia no, wɔde dua akyerɛkyerɛkwan ketewa bi na ɛdanedane no kɔ baabiara a hyɛn kwankyerɛfoɔ no pɛ. 5Saa ara na tɛkyerɛma nso yɛ ɔhonam akwaa mu ade ketewa, nanso ɔhoahoa ne ho ade kɛseɛ ho. Ogya ketewa nso, monhwɛ kwaeɛ kɛseɛ a ɛbɛtumi asɔ!
6 # Mat 15.11; 15.18-19; 12.36-37 Na tɛkyerɛma nso yɛ ogya. Tɛkyerɛma yɛ wiase bi wɔ yɛn akwaa mu a ɛyɛ deɛ ɛntene. Ɛde nkekaeɛ keka nipadua nyinaa, na ɛsɔ nkwa nkyimiiɛ a ɛtwa ne ho firi awoɔ mu no, na ɛfiri amanehunu kuro no mu na wɔasɔ ano. 7Na ntɔteboa ne ntakraboa ne mmoa a wɔwea ne mmoa a ɛwɔ po mu su nyinaa, nnipa de wɔn su dwodwo wɔn, na wɔadwodwo wɔn. 8#Dwom 140.3 Na tɛkyerɛma deɛ, onipa biara ntumi nnwodwo no, ɛyɛ adebɔne a ɛyɛ werɛmfoɔ a awuduro ayɛ no ma. 9#Gye 1.27 Ɛno na yɛde hyira Awurade ne Agya no, ɛno ara nso na yɛde dome nnipa a wɔayɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn suban soɔ. 10Ano korɔ no ara mu na nhyira ne nnome fire. Me nuanom, ɛnsɛ sɛ yeinom ba saa! 11Asutire bi firi nsu dɛdɛ ne nwononwono wɔ ani korɔ mu anaa? 12Me nuanom, borɔdɔma bɛtumi aso ngo dua aba anaa? Anaasɛ obobe bɛtumi aso borɔdɔma? Saa ara nso na asutire nkyenenkyene rentumi mma nsu pa.
Nyansa ahodoɔ mmienu
13 # Yak 2.18 Mo mu hwan na ɔyɛ nyansafoɔ ne nimdefoɔ? Ma no mfa ɔbra pa nkyerɛ ne nnwuma wɔ ɔdwoɔ a nyansa wɔ mu mu. 14#Efe 4.31 Na sɛ mowɔ nitanmmɔne ne mansotwe mo akoma mu a, ɛnneɛ monnhoahoa mo ho, na monnni atorɔ nntia nokorɛ. 15#Yak 1.5; 1.17 Saa nyansa yi mfiri soro, na mmom ɛyɛ fam ne ɔkra ne ahonhommɔne deɛ. 16Na deɛ nitan ne mansotwe wɔ no, ɛhɔ na sakasaka ne nneyɛɛ bɔne nyinaa wɔ. 17Na nyansa a ɛfiri soro no deɛ, deɛ ɛdi kan ne sɛ ɛho te, ɛwɔ asomdwoeɛ, ɛwɔ ɔdwoɔ, ɛwɔ asoɔmmerɛ; mmɔborɔhunu ne aba pa ayɛ no ma, ɛnnye akyinnyeɛ, ɛnyɛ nyaatwom. 18#Yes 32.17; Mat 5.9 Na wɔgu tenenee aba asomdwoeɛ mu ma wɔn a wɔyɛ asomdwoeɛ adeɛ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Me nuanom, mommma mo mu bebree nnyɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, na monim sɛ yɛbɛnya afobuo kɛseɛ mmom. Ɛfiri sɛ yɛn nyinaa fom wɔ nnoɔma bebree mu. Sɛ obi mfom asɛm mu a, ɔno ara na ɔyɛ onipa a ɔwie pɛyɛ a ɔbɛtumi ato nipadua nyinaa nnareka adi soɔ. Yɛde nnareka to apɔnkɔ ano mu sɛ wɔntie yɛn, na yɛdanedane wɔn kɔ faako a yɛpɛ. Hwɛ, ɛhyɛn nso a ɛsoso sɛɛ, na mframa a emu yɛ den pia no, wɔde dua akyerɛkyerɛkwan ketewa bi na ɛdanedane no kɔ baabiara a hyɛn kwankyerɛfoɔ no pɛ. Saa ara na tɛkyerɛma nso yɛ ɔhonam akwaa mu ade ketewa, nanso ɔhoahoa ne ho ade kɛseɛ ho. Ogya ketewa nso, monhwɛ kwaeɛ kɛseɛ a ɛbɛtumi asɔ!
Na tɛkyerɛma nso yɛ ogya. Tɛkyerɛma yɛ wiase bi wɔ yɛn akwaa mu a ɛyɛ deɛ ɛntene. Ɛde nkekaeɛ keka nipadua nyinaa, na ɛsɔ nkwa nkyimiiɛ a ɛtwa ne ho firi awoɔ mu no, na ɛfiri amanehunu kuro no mu na wɔasɔ ano. Na ntɔteboa ne ntakraboa ne mmoa a wɔwea ne mmoa a ɛwɔ po mu su nyinaa, nnipa de wɔn su dwodwo wɔn, na wɔadwodwo wɔn. Na tɛkyerɛma deɛ, onipa biara ntumi nnwodwo no, ɛyɛ adebɔne a ɛyɛ werɛmfoɔ a awuduro ayɛ no ma. Ɛno na yɛde hyira Awurade ne Agya no, ɛno ara nso na yɛde dome nnipa a wɔayɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn suban soɔ. Ano korɔ no ara mu na nhyira ne nnome fire. Me nuanom, ɛnsɛ sɛ yeinom ba saa! Asutire bi firi nsu dɛdɛ ne nwononwono wɔ ani korɔ mu anaa? Me nuanom, borɔdɔma bɛtumi aso ngo dua aba anaa? Anaasɛ obobe bɛtumi aso borɔdɔma? Saa ara nso na asutire nkyenenkyene rentumi mma nsu pa.

Mo mu hwan na ɔyɛ nyansafoɔ ne nimdefoɔ? Ma no mfa ɔbra pa nkyerɛ ne nnwuma wɔ ɔdwoɔ a nyansa wɔ mu mu. Na sɛ mowɔ nitanmmɔne ne mansotwe mo akoma mu a, ɛnneɛ monnhoahoa mo ho, na monnni atorɔ nntia nokorɛ. Saa nyansa yi mfiri soro, na mmom ɛyɛ fam ne ɔkra ne ahonhommɔne deɛ. Na deɛ nitan ne mansotwe wɔ no, ɛhɔ na sakasaka ne nneyɛɛ bɔne nyinaa wɔ. Na nyansa a ɛfiri soro no deɛ, deɛ ɛdi kan ne sɛ ɛho te, ɛwɔ asomdwoeɛ, ɛwɔ ɔdwoɔ, ɛwɔ asoɔmmerɛ; mmɔborɔhunu ne aba pa ayɛ no ma, ɛnnye akyinnyeɛ, ɛnyɛ nyaatwom. Na wɔgu tenenee aba asomdwoeɛ mu ma wɔn a wɔyɛ asomdwoeɛ adeɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
